newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha weaker with crude, cargoes pressure.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha weaker with crude, cargoes pressure.

text.p: European spot naphtha markets were weaker on Tuesday in line with weaker crude and as unsold cargoes and a dearth of demand added further pressure on prices in NWE and the Mediterranean, traders said.

Traders said unsold cargoes were putting pressure on the front-end of the market pegging spot prices back to parity with July paper. Prompt and July paper deliveries for pipeline spec cargoes were talked around $173/$176 a tonne cif NWE with the spot market off around $3-4 a tonne on the day.
Forward sentiment indicators swaps were also weaker but showed a small contango developing further out with July swaps talked $1-2 lower at $172/$174 and August around $173/$175.
